Frequency once per encounter

Trigger Your turn begins while you are broadcasting

Traits Signal

You gain 2 Encore from the start of your turn instead of 1. Your cap applies normally: if the second point would take you past it, that point is lost like any other overflow, and this feat's use is still expended.
